findings.evidence: - [ ] 1.2 Document `--quiet` in `docs/cli.md`, verified by `cargo test docs_mention_every_flag`
findings.recommendation: Make task 1.1 add "--quiet" to `FLAGS` in `src/cli/import.rs` (today `pub const FLAGS: &[&str] = &[];`). `tests/docs.rs` only loops over `ledger::cli::import::FLAGS`, so while that list stays empty the test passes whether or not `docs/cli.md` mentions `--quiet`.
findings.title: Task 1.2's check passes even if `--quiet` is never declared

findings.evidence:
- **WHEN** the user runs `ledger import --quiet data.csv` and the import succeeds
- **THEN** no progress line is printed and the exit code is 0
findings.recommendation: Say in the scenario that `data.csv` has at least 1 000 data rows. `Progress::row` only prints every 1 000 rows (`every: 1000`), so with a smaller file the test `a_quiet_import_prints_nothing` passes even when `--quiet` does nothing.
findings.title: The "A quiet import" scenario passes without `--quiet` on a small file

findings.recommendation: Say how `quiet` reaches `import::run`. Its signature today is `pub fn run(path: &str) -> i32`, and the crate has no argument parser or binary (no `src/main.rs`). Either change the signature or name the caller that parses argv, and add that file to Impact if it is in this repository.
findings.title: The plan does not say how `--quiet` gets from the command line to `run`
